Thirty People Wide

Breaking News Broadcast · African & African Diaspora Voices
THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

The number card

As you record, the four numbers fill in. Take the low quarter from the high quarter. Then compare the average to the middle number.

THE SCENE

You read the news on the school news show. Tonight you tell how many people watch each week. You are alone in the news room with an empty number card. You need four numbers, and four people each have one.

THE HISTORY

Your show is named after Max Robinson. In 1978 he read the news on TV for the country. He was the first Black American to do it. He also helped start a group for Black news writers.
